title: operad dev repository settings
description: The settings in <repository>/.operad/dev.json, owned by the dev plugin.

name.description: The name this repository is registered under.

remote.description: The git remote task branches are fetched from and pushed to.

mainBranch.description: The branch a task branch starts from and merges before each attempt.

worktreeRoot.description: The directory task worktrees are kept in, relative to the repository and inside it.

worktrees.description: Deprecated: the old name of worktreeRoot, still read so earlier settings keep working.

sandbox.description: Deprecated and ignored; kept so settings written by an earlier version still validate.

worker.description: The harness step that works a task and the limits it runs under.

use.description: The harness step, such as harness-radian/agent.

args.description: Extra arguments the harness step passes to its command.

wallTimeSecs.description: The longest a worker may run, in seconds.

stallSecs.description: How long a worker may go without a new output line, in seconds.

workerBrief.description: The Markdown a worker reads before the task brief; a missing file means the built-in text.

gate.description: The commands a task's gate runs on its commit and how long each may take.

commands.description: The commands the verify step runs, in order, in a detached checkout of the task commit.

commandTimeoutSecs.description: The longest one gate command may run, in seconds.

reviewer.description: The harness step that reviews a task's diff and the limits it runs under.

use.description: The harness step, such as harness-radian/agent.

args.description: Extra arguments the harness step passes to its command.

firstArgs.description: Arguments used for the first review of an attempt, when they differ from args.

timeoutSecs.description: The longest a review may run, in seconds.

fixLevel.description: The lowest finding severity that fails the gate.

maxFileDiffBytes.description: The largest diff one file may put in the review prompt; a larger file is left out and listed.

maxDiffBytes.description: The largest diff the review prompt may carry; a larger change fails the review before a reviewer starts.

integration.description: How the integrate step builds the candidate and lands it on main.

style.description: Merge the verified commit with a merge commit, or squash it into one commit.

keyCommands.description: Commands the integrate step runs on the candidate before it pushes; the first failure sends the task back to the worker.

hooks.description: Commands the cleanup step runs after a merge, in the repository root, with OPERAD_TASK and OPERAD_WORKTREE set.

afterMerge.description: The commands cleanup runs after a merge; a failure is recorded and does not fail the task.

maxAutoRework.description: How many automatic reworks in a row are allowed before the flow waits for a person.
